raw.comments: Continue in Global mode and execute converse-bridge-infrastructure, not the final ConverseGame theorem yet. Attach the new helpers to Front, PrefixTree, InitialSegment, ProperInitialSegment, FiniteShift, and FrontTreeWellFounded. Preserve the unrestricted PowerQ and hereditary carrier, add no configured target node, and give complete cited TeX proofs for all new proof-bearing helpers.
